text.tspan: The TLS 1.3 handshake: one round trip, then encrypted data
Both sides computed the same keys (ECDHE): everything below is encrypted
Asymmetric keys prove identity and agree on fresh symmetric keys; symmetric crypto (AES-GCM, ChaCha20) encrypts the data.
Ephemeral (EC)DHE keys give forward secrecy: stealing the private key later doesn't decrypt recorded traffic.
ClientHello: TLS versions, cipher suites, key share (X25519)
CertificateVerify: signed with the server's private key
Finished: a hash of the whole handshake
